## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-stablecoin-index-2026-09-11`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-stablecoin-index-2026-09-11 -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `csoai-stablecoin-index-2026-09-11.csv`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `STATUS-2026-09-25.json`
- `csoai-stablecoin-index-2026-09-11.csv`
